lines: Whether you have walked with the Lord for decades or you are stepping through our doors for the very first time, there is a place for you at Cross Victory Church. We are an ordinary people serving an extraordinary God — and we have seen Him move.
Bring your questions, your burdens to the Lord Jesus.
Here in Blantyre, we gather to worship, to grow in the Word and to carry victory into every street and home. We would be honoured to walk this journey together with you.

When I left the Church of England( which I loved and raised from a Muslim community), it was not for pride or selfish reasons. When I left a full- time musical journey and cancelled my travel back to South Africa to work on two music deals; when I abandoned an employment opportunity in order to save the Lord full- time, it doesn’t mean that I had enough money and provisions. Brethren, I felt to start a full- time ministry to serve the Lord while following the teachings of the holy Apostles. I started this small church in the living room of my home. By then, no one stood with me except the Spirit of the Lord. At the point of this writing, I have known the Holy Spirit well, getting acquainted well and enjoyed His communion and have understood His great love that I have never experienced from anyone else. I have witnessed His marvelous acts and great miracles the world has never witnessed. The Holy Spirit is real and genuine; ministry is impossible and with no impact without Him. The Church should return back to that point where we left the Holy Spirit and replaced Him with money and physical resources. Money and physical resources are necessary but should follow the presence of the Holy Spirit otherwise, ministry will have no impact. We can write millions of books but if those books have no impact from the Holy Spirit, they cannot change anyone. Since my journey from a traditional and predominantly Muslim community with my music background, I have discovered someone the world has not really known and understood; He is the Holy Spirit which is the Stronghold and General Overseer of my ministry and calling. JESUS Christ is the founder. At the bottom; I am their servant.
We follow the Doctrine and the teachings of the holy Apostles and the prophecies of the holy prophet.

We don’t just plant Churches any where except where a great need requires that. We work with the Living Church everywhere. We believe that this is not the time of pride but of humility that JESUS alone may take all the glory. We also believe that it’s not the time of judging one another but helping carrying the burdens of one another and being a brother’s keeper. But on the other hand, it’s time not to tolerate false doctrines, teachings and prophecies. The days are evil and JESUS IS about to come for his holy Church so things have to be put in their right order.

We believe in baptism by emersion and in the Name of JESUS CHRIST. This was the practice of the holy Apostles for their teachings and their practice will not contradict. So, we baptise as the holy Apostles conducted baptism.

In short, we strictly follow the teachings or the doctrine of the holy Apostles. But we gather and worship on Saturdays and with an extra mid- week service. We have other evangelism programs as well- in order to reach masses out therelieve in the baptism by immersion and in the name of JESUS CHRIST. We believe in baptism of the Holy Spirit and spiritual gifts. We treat the gift of tongues exactly how the Apostles handled it: You should speak in tongues in the Church if there is someone to interpret. Otherwise, you can speak alone- before the Lord.
Because of my musical background, music is an important part in worship. We value hymns, choruses and choir sounds as part of our worship.
Since I have a background of music, we like worship music, hyms and spiritual songs.
Feel free to connect with us. We are open, humble and caring.
“And this gospel of the kingdom willh be preached in all the world as a witness to all the nations, and then the end will come.
Join us this week — everyone is welcome.
There is a place for every age and every calling to grow and to serve.
Bible foundations for all ages, every Sunday morning before service.
A vibrant space for teens and young adults to find purpose and community.
Sisters gathering for prayer, encouragement, and shared strength in faith.
Men sharpening one another to lead their homes and church with integrity.
Lifting Malawi’s voice in song and leading the congregation into His presence.
Serving the vulnerable across Blantyre with food, care, and the gospel.
Going deeper into the Scriptures. Deep knowledge of the Scriptures is vital for a Christian walk. Bible knowledge should be encouraged among Christians.
